signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expected_sqErr_step_le_add.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
  (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xh x : n → ℝ) (σ : ℝ)
  (hσ : ∀ (v : n → ℝ), σ ^ 2 * v ⬝ᵥ v ≤ A.mulVec v ⬝ᵥ A.mulVec v) :
  ∑ i, NLAlib.Kaczmarz.prob A i * (NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step A b x i - xh) ⬝ᵥ (NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step A b x i - xh) ≤
    (1 - σ ^ 2 / NLAlib.frobSq A) * (x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh) + (b - A.mulVec xh) ⬝ᵥ (b - A.mulVec xh) / NLAlib.frobSq A
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expected_sqErr_step_le_add
doc:
One-step bound for inconsistent systems: if `σ²‖v‖² ≤ ‖Av‖²` for all `v`, then for any `xh`
`∑ᵢ pᵢ ‖step A b x i − xh‖² ≤ (1 − σ²/‖A‖_F²) ‖x − xh‖² + ‖b − A xh‖²/‖A‖_F²`.
Source: Needell (2010) [`needell10`], proof of Thm 2.1. Atlas: `kaczmarz-inconsistent`.

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expected_sqErr_step_le_add_of_sub_mem_range.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype m]
  [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xh x : n → ℝ) (σ : ℝ)
  (hσ : ∀ v ∈ A.transpose.mulVecLin.range, σ ^ 2 * v ⬝ᵥ v ≤ A.mulVec v ⬝ᵥ A.mulVec v)
  (hx : x - xh ∈ A.transpose.mulVecLin.range) :
  ∑ i, NLAlib.Kaczmarz.prob A i * (NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step A b x i - xh) ⬝ᵥ (NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step A b x i - xh) ≤
    (1 - σ ^ 2 / NLAlib.frobSq A) * (x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh) + (b - A.mulVec xh) ⬝ᵥ (b - A.mulVec xh) / NLAlib.frobSq A
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expected_sqErr_step_le_add_of_sub_mem_range
doc:
One inconsistent-system Kaczmarz step contracts a row-space error, with
additive noise `‖b-A*xh‖²/‖A‖F²`. The lower singular bound is needed only on
the row space. Needell 2010, proof of Theorem 2.1;
atlas `kaczmarz-inconsistent` (one-step helper).

signature: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.prob.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (i : m) : ℝ
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.prob
doc:
Row-selection probability `‖A i‖² / ‖A‖_F²` of randomized Kaczmarz.
Strohmer–Vershynin 2009, Algorithm; atlas `randomized-kaczmarz`.
atlas: kaczmarz-def

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.prob_nonneg.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
  (i : m) : 0 ≤ NLAlib.Kaczmarz.prob A i
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.prob_nonneg
doc: Selection probabilities are nonnegative. Atlas `randomized-kaczmarz`.

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.rate_nonneg_of_lower_bound_on_range.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
  [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (σ : ℝ)
  (hσ : ∀ v ∈ A.transpose.mulVecLin.range, σ ^ 2 * v ⬝ᵥ v ≤ A.mulVec v ⬝ᵥ A.mulVec v) : 0 ≤ 1 - σ ^ 2 / NLAlib.frobSq A
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.rate_nonneg_of_lower_bound_on_range
doc:
A lower singular bound on the row space makes the Kaczmarz contraction
factor nonnegative, including a zero matrix and empty index types.
Zouzias–Freris 2013, equation (5); atlas `kaczmarz-inconsistent`, `randomized-kaczmarz` (rate
helper).

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.run.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
  (Fin k → m) → (n → ℝ) → n → ℝ
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.run
doc:
The iterate after applying the steps with rows `ω 0, ω 1, …, ω (k-1)` in that order,
starting from `x`. Atlas `randomized-kaczmarz`.
atlas: kaczmarz-def

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sqErr_step.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ)
  (xs x : n → ℝ) (hxs : A.mulVec xs = b) (i : m) :
  (NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step A b x i - xs) ⬝ᵥ (NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step A b x i - xs) =
    (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs) - (A i ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)) ^ 2 / A i ⬝ᵥ A i
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sqErr_step
doc:
Pythagoras for one Kaczmarz step (the step is an orthogonal projection onto a hyperplane
containing `xs`): `‖step A b x i - xs‖² = ‖x - xs‖² - (A i ⬝ᵥ (x - xs))² / ‖A i‖²`.
Holds for every row; for a zero row both sides equal `‖x - xs‖²`.
Strohmer–Vershynin 2009, proof of Thm 2; atlas `randomized-kaczmarz`.

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sqErr_step_eq_add.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ)
  (xh x : n → ℝ) (i : m) :
  (NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step A b x i - xh) ⬝ᵥ (NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step A b x i - xh) =
    (x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh) - (A i ⬝ᵥ (x - xh)) ^ 2 / A i ⬝ᵥ A i + (b i - A i ⬝ᵥ xh) ^ 2 / A i ⬝ᵥ A i
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sqErr_step_eq_add
doc:
One Kaczmarz step from an arbitrary reference point `xh` (no consistency assumed): with
`e = b − A xh`,
`‖step A b x i − xh‖² = ‖x − xh‖² − (Aᵢ ⬝ (x − xh))²/‖Aᵢ‖² + eᵢ²/‖Aᵢ‖²`.
Source: Needell (2010) [`needell10`], proof of Thm 2.1. Atlas: `kaczmarz-inconsistent`.

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (x : n → ℝ)
  (i : m) : n → ℝ
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step
doc:
One Kaczmarz step on row `i`: the orthogonal projection of `x` onto the hyperplane
`{y | A i ⬝ᵥ y = b i}`. For a zero row the step is the identity (real division by zero is `0`).
Strohmer–Vershynin 2009, Algorithm (eq. (2)); atlas `randomized-kaczmarz`.
atlas: kaczmarz-def

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step_sub_mem_range_of_sub_mem_range.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
  [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xh x : n → ℝ) (hx : x - xh ∈ A.transpose.mulVecLin.range) (i : m) :
  NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step A b x i - xh ∈ A.transpose.mulVecLin.range
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step_sub_mem_range_of_sub_mem_range
doc:
An arbitrary affine Kaczmarz update preserves row-space error membership.
No consistency assumption on the right-hand side or reference point is needed.
Needell 2010, proof of Theorem 2.1; atlas `kaczmarz-inconsistent` (invariant helper).

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step_sub_solution.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ)
  (xs x : n → ℝ) (hxs : A.mulVec xs = b) (i : m) :
  NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step A b x i - xs = x - xs - (A i ⬝ᵥ (x - xs) / A i ⬝ᵥ A i) • A i
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step_sub_solution
doc:
Error recursion of one Kaczmarz step when `A *ᵥ xs = b`:
`step A b x i - xs = (x - xs) - ((A i ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)) / ‖A i‖²) • A i`.
Strohmer–Vershynin 2009, proof of Thm 2; atlas `randomized-kaczmarz`.

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_paths_le.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
  (b : m → ℝ) (xs : n → ℝ) (hxs : A.mulVec xs = b) (σ : ℝ)
  (hσ : ∀ (v : n → ℝ), σ ^ 2 * v ⬝ᵥ v ≤ A.mulVec v ⬝ᵥ A.mulVec v) (x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
  ∑ ω,
      (∏ j, NLAlib.Kaczmarz.prob A (ω j)) *
        (NLAlib.Kaczmarz.run A b k ω x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (NLAlib.Kaczmarz.run A b k ω x - xs) ≤
    (1 - σ ^ 2 / NLAlib.frobSq A) ^ k * (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_paths_le
doc:
Path-sum form of SV09 Thm 2: the weighted average over all row sequences of length `k` of
the squared error is at most `(1 - σ² / ‖A‖_F²)^k ‖x - xs‖²`.
Strohmer–Vershynin 2009, Thm 2; atlas `randomized-kaczmarz`.

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_prob.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
  (hA : A ≠ 0) : ∑ i, NLAlib.Kaczmarz.prob A i = 1
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_prob
doc: The selection probabilities sum to one when `A ≠ 0`. Atlas `randomized-kaczmarz`.

signature: NLAlib.LUPartialPivotSucceeds {n : ℕ} : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ → Prop
name: NLAlib.LUPartialPivotSucceeds
doc:
**Success of partial pivoting**: every pivot (after the row swap) is nonzero.
Golub–Van Loan 2013, §3.4.
atlas: lu-partial-pivoting

signature: NLAlib.LUSucceeds {n : ℕ} : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ → Prop
name: NLAlib.LUSucceeds
doc:
**Success of Gaussian elimination**: every pivot (the `(1,1)` entry of `A` and of each
successive Schur complement) is nonzero. All `n` pivots are required, so success also gives an
invertible `U`; the realisation `A = LU` itself only uses the first `n − 1` (see
`exists_isLU_of_forall_det_ne_zero`). Trefethen–Bau 1997, Lect. 20; Golub–Van Loan 2013, §3.2.
atlas: lu-algorithm

signature: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) : Type u_1
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp
doc:
A **Lanczos decomposition**: an Arnoldi decomposition, used for symmetric `A` (then
`T = Qᵀ A Q` is a Jacobi matrix, `LanczosDecomp.T`). Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`],
Ch. 4.
atlas: lanczos-recurrence

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
  (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℝ
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T
doc:
The Jacobi matrix `T_q = Q_qᵀ A Q_q` of a Lanczos decomposition (the Hessenberg matrix `H_q`
under its Lanczos name). Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Ch. 4.
atlas: lanczos-recurrence

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_apply_eq_zero_of_one_lt_dist
doc:
**For symmetric `A`, `T_q` is tridiagonal**: `t_ij = 0` whenever `|i − j| > 1`.
Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Thm 4.2; Trefethen–Bau (1997) [`tb97`], Lect. 36.
atlas: lanczos-recurrence, graded-krylov-basis-def (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_eq_jacobiMatrix.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ}
  {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) : D.T = NLAlib.jacobiMatrix D.alpha D.beta q
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_eq_jacobiMatrix
doc:
For symmetric `A`, `T_q` is the Jacobi matrix of its recurrence coefficients:
`T_q = jacobiMatrix α β q`. Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Thm 4.2.
Atlas: `jacobi-matrix-identities`.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.X_mul_poly.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
  (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {j : ℕ} (hj : j + 1 < q) :
  Polynomial.X * D.poly j =
    Polynomial.C (D.beta j) * D.poly (j - 1) + Polynomial.C (D.alpha j) * D.poly j +
      Polynomial.C (D.beta (j + 1)) * D.poly (j + 1)
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.X_mul_poly
doc:
**Three-term recurrence of the Lanczos polynomials**: for symmetric `A` and `j + 1 < q`,
`X p_j = β_j p_{j−1} + α_j p_j + β_{j+1} p_{j+1}`, so the Jacobi matrix `T` holds the recurrence
coefficients of the orthonormal polynomials of `μ_b`. Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`],
Thm 2.1 and Thm 4.2.
atlas: lanczos-orthogonal-polynomials (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.alpha.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
  (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (j : ℕ) : ℝ
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.alpha
doc:
The Lanczos diagonal coefficient `α_j = t_jj = q_jᵀ A q_j` (`0` for `j ≥ q`).
Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Alg. 4.1. Atlas: `lanczos-recurrence`.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.beta.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
  (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (j : ℕ) : ℝ
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.beta
doc:
The Lanczos off-diagonal coefficient `β_j = t_{j,j−1} = q_jᵀ A q_{j−1}` (`β_0 = 0`, and `0`
for `j ≥ q`). Indexing: `A q_j = β_j q_{j−1} + α_j q_j + β_{j+1} q_{j+1}` (0-based columns).
Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Alg. 4.1 (there `η_j`). Atlas: `lanczos-recurrence`.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.beta_arnoldiDecomp_pos.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
  (b : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (h : q ≤ NLAlib.krylovGrade A b) {j : ℕ} (h0 : 0 < j) (hj : j < q) :
  0 < NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.beta (NLAlib.arnoldiDecomp A b q h) j
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.beta_arnoldiDecomp_pos
doc:
The canonical (Gram–Schmidt) decomposition has positive `β_j` for `0 < j < q`.
Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Alg. 4.1 (`η_j = ‖v_j‖ > 0`).
Atlas: `lanczos-recurrence`.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.beta_ne_zero.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ}
  {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) {j : ℕ} (h0 : 0 < j) (hj : j < q) : D.beta j ≠ 0
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.beta_ne_zero
doc:
The Lanczos off-diagonal coefficients do not vanish below the grade: `β_j ≠ 0` for
`0 < j < q`. Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Thm 4.2 (no breakdown before the grade).
Atlas: `lanczos-recurrence`.

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.cfc_T_apply_zero_zero
doc:
**Golub–Welsch**: `e₁ᵀ f(T_q) e₁ = ∑ᵢ f(θᵢ) (uᵢ)₁²` with `(θᵢ, uᵢ)` the eigenpairs of
`T_q`: the Gauss rule has the eigenvalues of `T_q` as nodes and the squared first components
of its eigenvectors as weights. Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Ch. 6 (Golub–Welsch).
atlas: jacobi-matrix-identities (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_T_monic.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ}
  {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) : D.T.charpoly.Monic ∧ D.T.charpoly.natDegree = q
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_T_monic
doc: `charpoly T_q` is monic of degree `q`. Atlas: `lanczos-orthogonal-polynomials`.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_restrict_T_mul_poly_zero.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
  {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < q) :
  (NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T (NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.restrict D ⋯)).charpoly * D.poly 0 =
    Polynomial.C (∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 j, D.beta k) * D.poly j
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_restrict_T_mul_poly_zero
doc:
**`det(x I − T_j)` is proportional to the Lanczos polynomial `p_j`**:
`χ_j p_0 = β_1 ⋯ β_j p_j` with `χ_j = charpoly T_j` (`p_0 = ±1/‖b‖` is a constant; for
`‖b‖ = 1` and the canonical signs this is `det(x I − T_j) = β_1 ⋯ β_j p_j(x)`).
Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Ch. 3 and Thm 4.2 (labels to verify).
atlas: lanczos-orthogonal-polynomials

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.col_dotProduct_vec.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ}
  {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (i : Fin q) (k : ℕ) : D.Q.col i ⬝ᵥ D.vec k = if ↑i = k then 1 else 0
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.col_dotProduct_vec
doc: `q_i ⬝ q_k = δ_ik` in the `ℕ`-indexed form. Atlas: `lanczos-recurrence`.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.degree_poly.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
  (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < q) : (D.poly j).degree = ↑j
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.degree_poly
doc: `deg p_j = j` for `j < q`. Atlas: `lanczos-orthogonal-polynomials`.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.degree_poly_le.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ}
  {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (j : ℕ) : (D.poly j).degree ≤ ↑j
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.degree_poly_le
doc: The Lanczos polynomials have degree at most `j` (exactly `j` for `j < q`).

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq
doc:
**Gauss–Lanczos quadrature through the Jacobi matrix**: for symmetric `A`, `q ≥ 1` and
`deg p < 2q`, `bᵀ p(A) b = ‖b‖² (p(T_q))₁₁`. Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Thm 6.6
and §7.1; Chen–Trogdon–Ubaru (2021) [`ctu21`], Thm 2.1. Deviation: the degree bound is
`p.degree < 2 * q` (no `natDegree`, no truncated subtraction).
atlas: lanczos-gauss-quadrature

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum
doc:
**Gauss quadrature through the Jacobi matrix**: for symmetric `A`, `q ≥ 1` and
`deg p < 2q`, `bᵀ p(A) b = ‖b‖² ∑ᵢ p(θᵢ) (uᵢ)₁²` with nodes `θᵢ` the eigenvalues of `T_q` and
weights the squared first eigenvector components. Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`],
Thm 6.6; Chen–Trogdon–Ubaru (2021) [`ctu21`], Thm 2.1.
atlas: lanczos-gauss-quadrature, jacobi-matrix-identities (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.dotProduct_cfc_T_mulVec_eq_sum.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
  {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
  D.Q.transpose.mulVec b ⬝ᵥ (cfc f D.T).mulVec (D.Q.transpose.mulVec b) =
    b ⬝ᵥ b * ∑ i, f (⋯.eigenvalues i) * (⋯.eigenvectorBasis i).ofLp ⟨0, hq⟩ ^ 2
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.dotProduct_cfc_T_mulVec_eq_sum
doc:
**The Lanczos quadrature value is a Gauss rule**: `(Q_qᵀ b)ᵀ f(T_q) (Q_qᵀ b) =
‖b‖² ∑ᵢ f(θᵢ) (uᵢ)₁²` for every `f`. Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Thm 6.6 and §7.1;
Ubaru–Chen–Saad (2017) [`ucs17`], §3.
atlas: jacobi-matrix-identities (partial), lanczos-gauss-quadrature (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_restrict_T.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
  {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {q' : ℕ} (h : q' ≤ q)
  (i : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin q'))) :
  ⋯.eigenvalues₀ ⟨↑i + (Fintype.card (Fin q) - Fintype.card (Fin q')), ⋯⟩ ≤ ⋯.eigenvalues₀ i
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_restrict_T
doc:
**Cauchy interlacing, lower half**: `θ_{i + (q − q')}(T_q) ≤ θ_i(T_{q'})` for `q' ≤ q`;
with `q' = q − 1` and the upper half, the eigenvalues of `T_{q−1}` interlace those of `T_q`.
Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Ch. 3; Horn–Johnson (2013) [`hj13`],
Thm 4.3.17.
Deviation: non-strict.
atlas: jacobi-matrix-identities (partial)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.eigenvalues₀_restrict_T_le
doc:
**Cauchy interlacing, upper half**: the eigenvalues of `T_{q'}` (`q' ≤ q`, a leading
principal submatrix of `T_q`) satisfy `θ_i(T_{q'}) ≤ θ_i(T_q)` (eigenvalues in non-increasing
order). Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Ch. 3 (interlacing);
Horn–Johnson (2013) [`hj13`], Thm 4.3.17. Deviation: non-strict.
atlas: jacobi-matrix-identities (partial)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.exists_col_eq_aeval
doc:
Each Lanczos vector is a polynomial of exact degree `j` in `A` applied to `b`:
`q_j = p_j(A) b` with `deg p_j = j`. Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Thm 4.2 (§4.1).
Atlas: `lanczos-orthogonal-polynomials`.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.integral_eval_charpoly_mul_eq_zero.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
  {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {r : Polynomial ℝ}
  (hr : r.degree < ↑q) :
  ∫ (x : ℝ), Polynomial.eval x D.T.charpoly * Polynomial.eval x r ∂NLAlib.spectralMeasure hA b = 0
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.integral_eval_charpoly_mul_eq_zero
doc:
**`det(x I − T_q)` is the monic orthogonal polynomial of degree `q`**: for symmetric `A`,
`χ_q = charpoly T_q` (monic of degree `q`, `charpoly_T_monic`, `natDegree_charpoly_T`) is
orthogonal in `μ_b` to every polynomial of degree `< q`. Source: Golub–Meurant (2010)
[`gm10`], Thm 4.2 and §3.1 (`p_q` and `det(λI − J_q)` are proportional).
atlas: lanczos-orthogonal-polynomials (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.integral_poly_mul_poly.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
  {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i j : ℕ} (hi : i < q) :
  ∫ (x : ℝ), Polynomial.eval x (D.poly i) * Polynomial.eval x (D.poly j) ∂NLAlib.spectralMeasure hA b =
    if i = j then 1 else 0
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.integral_poly_mul_poly
doc:
**The Lanczos polynomials are orthonormal for the spectral measure**:
`∫ p_i p_j dμ_b = δ_ij` for `i < q` (and any `j`; `p_j = 0` for `j ≥ q`).
Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Thm 4.2 and §2.1; Greenbaum (1997) [`greenbaum97`], §2.5.
atlas: lanczos-orthogonal-polynomials

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.inv_smul_one_sub_T_apply_zero_zero
doc:
**The resolvent entry is the Jacobi continued fraction**: for symmetric `A`, `q ≥ 1` and
`x` above the spectrum of `A`, `e₁ᵀ (x I − T_q)⁻¹ e₁ = 1/(x − α₀ − β₁²/(x − α₁ − ⋯ −
β_{q−1}²/(x − α_{q−1})))`, the `q`-th convergent of the continued fraction of the Stieltjes
transform `∫ dμ_b(t)/(x − t)` (for `‖b‖ = 1`). Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Ch. 3
(continued fractions) and Thm 4.2. Deviation: real `x` above the spectrum
(so every trailing block is nonsingular); complex `x` off the real axis is not covered.
atlas: jacobi-matrix-identities (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.isHermitian_T.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ}
  {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) : D.T.IsHermitian
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.isHermitian_T
doc: The Jacobi matrix of a symmetric `A` is Hermitian. Atlas: `lanczos-recurrence`.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.isSymm_T.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
  (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) : D.T.IsSymm
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.isSymm_T
doc: For symmetric `A`, `T_q` is symmetric. Atlas: `lanczos-recurrence`.

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.mulVec_vec_eq
doc:
**The Lanczos three-term recurrence** (column form): for symmetric `A` and `j + 1 < q`,
`A q_j = β_j q_{j−1} + α_j q_j + β_{j+1} q_{j+1}` (with `β_0 = 0`). Together with
`ArnoldiDecomp.mul_restrict_Q_eq_add_smul` this is `A Q_q = Q_q T_q + β_q q_{q+1} e_qᵀ`.
Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Thm 4.2; Trefethen–Bau (1997) [`tb97`], Lect. 36,
eq. (36.3).
atlas: lanczos-recurrence, arnoldi-relation (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.mul_restrict_Q_eq_add_beta_smul.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
  {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b (q + 1)) (hq : 0 < q) :
  A * (NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.restrict D ⋯).Q =
    (NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.restrict D ⋯).Q * NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T (NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.restrict D ⋯) +
      D.beta q • Matrix.vecMulVec (D.vec q) (Pi.single ⟨q - 1, ⋯⟩ 1)
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.mul_restrict_Q_eq_add_beta_smul
doc:
**The Lanczos relation** `A Q_q = Q_q T_q + β_q q_{q+1} e_qᵀ` (for `q ≥ 1`), with
`β_q = t_{q,q−1}` and `q_{q+1}` the last column of a decomposition of size `q + 1`; together with
`T_apply_eq_zero_of_one_lt_dist` (`T_q` symmetric tridiagonal for symmetric `A`) and
`ArnoldiDecomp.hasOrthonormalCols`, `ArnoldiDecomp.range_Q` this is the Lanczos
tridiagonalisation. Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Thm 4.2; Chen–Trogdon–Ubaru (2021)
[`ctu21`], §2.
atlas: lanczos-recurrence

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.poly.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
  (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (j : ℕ) : Polynomial ℝ
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.poly
doc:
The **Lanczos polynomial** `p_j` (indexed by `ℕ`, `0` for `j ≥ q`): the polynomial of degree
`j` with `q_j = p_j(A) b` (unique below the grade, `eq_zero_of_aeval_mulVec_eq_zero`).
Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], §4.1 and Ch. 2. Atlas: `lanczos-orthogonal-polynomials`.

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.posDef_smul_one_sub_T
doc: For `x` above the spectrum of `A`, `x I − T_q` is positive definite.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sub_mul_sum_eval_poly_mul.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
  {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {m : ℕ} (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : m < q)
  (x y : ℝ) :
  (x - y) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, Polynomial.eval x (D.poly j) * Polynomial.eval y (D.poly j) =
    D.beta m *
      (Polynomial.eval x (D.poly m) * Polynomial.eval y (D.poly (m - 1)) -
        Polynomial.eval x (D.poly (m - 1)) * Polynomial.eval y (D.poly m))
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sub_mul_sum_eval_poly_mul
doc:
**Christoffel–Darboux identity** for the Lanczos polynomials: for symmetric `A` and
`1 ≤ m < q`, `(x − y) ∑_{j<m} p_j(x) p_j(y) = β_m (p_m(x) p_{m−1}(y) − p_{m−1}(x) p_m(y))`.
Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Ch. 2 (Christoffel–Darboux formula).
atlas: jacobi-matrix-identities (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
  {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) :

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero
doc:
The Gauss weights sum to one: `∑ᵢ (uᵢ)₁² = 1`. Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`],
Thm 6.6. Atlas: `jacobi-matrix-identities`.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.vec.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}

NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.vec_mem.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}

The state of the Lanczos recursion at step `j`: the previous vector `q_{j−1}` (`0` for

Source: Trefethen–Bau (1997) [`tb97`], Alg. 36.1. Atlas: `lanczos-recurrence-algorithm`.

doc:
Ordinary majorization is weak majorization together with equality of the
full coordinate totals. Marshall–Olkin–Arnold, Definition 1.A.1.

signature:
NLAlib.Majorized.exists_perm_sum_mul_le.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] {x y : ι → ℝ} (hxy : NLAlib.Majorized x y)
  (a : ι → ℝ) : ∃ σ, ∑ i, a i * x i ≤ ∑ i, a i * y (σ i)
name: NLAlib.Majorized.exists_perm_sum_mul_le
doc:
For any real weights, a majorized vector has a pairing bounded by a
permutation of the comparator. This is the exact support bound used in HLP.
Marshall–Olkin–Arnold (2011), Theorem 2.B.2.

NLAlib.Majorized.mem_convexHull_permutations.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {x y : ι → ℝ}

A majorized vector belongs to the convex hull of the comparator's
permutations. The proof separates the compact convex hull and contradicts the
signed support bound. Marshall–Olkin–Arnold (2011), Theorem 2.B.2.

name: NLAlib.Majorized.refl

Majorization implies the sum inequality for every real convex function.

Majorization bounds every sorted-weight support functional.

signature: NLAlib.OperatorConvexOn (I : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop
name: NLAlib.OperatorConvexOn
doc:
`f` is **operator convex** on the convex set `I`: `f (t A + (1−t) H) ≼ t f(A) + (1−t) f(H)`
for all Hermitian complex matrices `A`, `H` of every size with spectra in `I`. "Every size" is
encoded as `∀ d : ℕ, … Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ` (universe-safe; `Fintype` index types reduce to
it by reindexing, `OperatorConvexOn.cfc_conjTranspose_mul_mul_le`); the size `d = 0` holds
trivially. The definition is over `ℂ`; the real case follows by complexification. Tropp 2015,
Def. 8.4.6.
atlas: operator-monotone-convex

signature:
NLAlib.OperatorConvexOn.cfc_conjTranspose_mul_mul_le.{u_1, u_2} {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} [Fintype ι]
  [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Nonempty κ] (I : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
  (hf : NLAlib.OperatorConvexOn I f) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hAI : spectrum ℝ A ⊆ I) (K : Matrix ι κ ℂ)
  (hK : K.conjTranspose * K = 1) : cfc f (K.conjTranspose * A * K) ≤ K.conjTranspose * cfc f A * K
name: NLAlib.OperatorConvexOn.cfc_conjTranspose_mul_mul_le
doc:
Operator Jensen inequality for an isometry: if `f` is operator convex on `I` and `Kᴴ K = 1`, then
`f (Kᴴ A K) ≼ Kᴴ f(A) K`.

Tropp 2015, Thm 8.5.2 (single-isometry form). Atlas: `operator-monotone-convex`. Ported from the
Prove2me mission *An Introduction to Matrix Concentration Inequalities, Ch 8*.

signature:
NLAlib.QRAlgorithmSucceeds {n : ℕ} (qr : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ × Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
  (μ : ℕ → ℝ) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) : Prop
name: NLAlib.QRAlgorithmSucceeds
doc:
**Success predicate**: each of the first `k` factor pairs is a QR factorization of the
matrix it was computed from, `A_j − μ_j I = Q_{j+1} R_{j+1}` with `Q_{j+1}` orthogonal and
`R_{j+1}` upper triangular. The QR algorithm itself never breaks down; this records that `qr`
did its job along the run. Source: Trefethen–Bau (1997) [`tb97`], Alg. 28.1.
atlas: qr-algorithm-simultaneous-iteration

name: NLAlib.QRAlgorithmSucceeds.mono
doc:
The success predicate is monotone in `k`. Helper for
`qr-algorithm-simultaneous-iteration`.

doc:
The subsets of a finite index type having the size of the given minor
coordinate type: `ExactRowSubset k (Fintype.card r)`. Horn–Johnson §0.8.7, compound matrix
index vocabulary.

NLAlib.SketchProject.dotProduct_expectedProjector_mulVec_le.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2}

name: NLAlib.SketchProject.dotProduct_expectedProjector_mulVec_le

signature:
NLAlib.SketchProject.expErr.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} {s : Type u_3} {J : Type u_4} [Fintype m]
  [Fintype n] [Fintype s] [Fintype J] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (p : J → ℝ) (S : J → Matrix m s ℝ) (xs : n → ℝ) :
  (n → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ
name: NLAlib.SketchProject.expErr
doc:
The finite weighted squared-error recurrence. With normalized nonnegative weights,
`integral_sqErr_pathLaw` identifies it with the expectation after `k` iid sketch steps:
`expErr 0 x = ‖x − xs‖²`, `expErr (k+1) x = ∑ⱼ pⱼ expErr k (step A b (S j) x)`.
Atlas: `sketch-and-project`.
atlas: sketch-and-project

signature:
NLAlib.SketchProject.expErr_eq_sum_paths.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} {s : Type u_3}
  {J : Type u_4} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype s] [Fintype J] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (p : J → ℝ)
  (S : J → Matrix m s ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
  NLAlib.SketchProject.expErr A b p S xs x k =
    ∑ ω, (∏ j, p (ω j)) * (NLAlib.SketchProject.run A b S k ω x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (NLAlib.SketchProject.run A b S k ω x - xs)
name: NLAlib.SketchProject.expErr_eq_sum_paths
doc: The error recurrence computes the finite path-weighted squared errors.

name: NLAlib.SketchProject.expErr_le
doc:
**Sketch-and-project converges linearly in expectation.** Let `A xs = b`, `pⱼ ≥ 0`,
`∑ pⱼ = 1`, and `λ ‖v‖² ≤ vᵀ W v` for all `v`, with `W = ∑ⱼ pⱼ (SⱼᵀA)⁺(SⱼᵀA)`. Then after `k`
steps with i.i.d. sketches, `E‖x_k − xs‖² ≤ (1 − λ)^k ‖x₀ − xs‖²`.
Source: Gower–Richtárik (2015) [`gr15`], Thm 4.6 (`B = I`; the sharp `λ` is
`λ_min⁺(W)`). Atlas: `sketch-and-project`; uses `pseudoinverse`. Deviation: finite sketch
distribution; expectation modelled by first-step recursion.

  [Fintype s] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (S : Matrix m s ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) : n → ℝ
name: NLAlib.SketchProject.step
doc:
One sketch-and-project step with sketch `S`: the Euclidean projection of `x` onto
`{y | Sᵀ A y = Sᵀ b}`, written `x − (SᵀA)⁺ Sᵀ (A x − b)`. Source: Gower–Richtárik (2015)
[`gr15`], eq. (2.2)–(2.3) with `B = I`. Atlas: `sketch-and-project`.
atlas: sketch-and-project

signature:
NLAlib.SketchProject.step_sub_mem_range.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} {s : Type u_3} [Fintype m]
  [Fintype n] [Fintype s] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (S : Matrix m s ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ)
  (hx : x - xs ∈ A.transpose.mulVecLin.range) : NLAlib.SketchProject.step A b S x - xs ∈ A.transpose.mulVecLin.range
name: NLAlib.SketchProject.step_sub_mem_range
doc:
A sketch-and-project update preserves membership of the error in `range Aᵀ`,
even for an arbitrary reference point and an inconsistent right-hand side.
The correction belongs to the row space because the Moore–Penrose inverse of `SᵀA`
has range contained in `range Aᵀ`. Gower–Richtárik 2015, eq. (2.3);
atlas `sketch-and-project` (invariant-space helper).

signature:
NLAlib.SketchProject.step_sub_solution.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} {s : Type u_3} [Fintype m]
  [Fintype n] [Fintype s] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (S : Matrix m s ℝ) {xs : n → ℝ} (hxs : A.mulVec xs = b)
  (x : n → ℝ) :
  NLAlib.SketchProject.step A b S x - xs =
    x - xs - (NLAlib.moorePenroseInverse (S.transpose * A) * (S.transpose * A)).mulVec (x - xs)
name: NLAlib.SketchProject.step_sub_solution
doc:
Error recursion: if `A xs = b` then `step A b S x − xs = (I − Z)(x − xs)` with the
projector `Z = (SᵀA)⁺(SᵀA)`. Source: Gower–Richtárik (2015) [`gr15`], eq. (4.3).
Atlas: `sketch-and-project`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_fullFiber {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_marked_reindex {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) :
  ∑ z,
      NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.contract F z.right x
          (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair z.pattern (z.row, z.left) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one
            (z.row, z.right) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero) ^
        2 =
    ∑ z, NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.contract F z.right x z.pattern ^ 2
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_marked_reindex
doc:
Exact coefficient-square reindexing for the transpose light hop.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.DirectionalConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_marked_synthesis_energy_le {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) :
  ∑ p,
      ∑ r,
        ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
          NLAlib.SparseSketch.euclideanNormSq (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprimeMarked F x p r c) ≤
    NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.markedEnergy NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero F x
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_marked_synthesis_energy_le
doc:
Heavy correction synthesis energy is bounded by the finite marked-pair contraction energy.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.DirectionalConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_mulVec_coeff {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) (k : Fin d) (σ : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  Matrix.mulVec (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime m F.rows) x (k, σ) =
    ∑ r,
      ∑ a ∈ σ.freshInRow r,
        ∑ c ∈ σ.lightInRow r,
          ∑ l,
            (F.u a).ofLp k * (F.u c).ofLp l *
              x
                (l,
                  NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair σ (r, a) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one (r, c)
                    NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_mulVec_coeff
doc:
Exact coefficient formula for the transpose light hop `H'`.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.DirectionalConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_mulVec_marked {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) (k : Fin d) (σ : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  Matrix.mulVec (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime m F.rows) x (k, σ) =
    ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ σ.lightInRow r, (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprimeMarked F x σ r c).ofLp k
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_mulVec_marked
doc:
Paper equation `(Hprime-coeff)` on the actual finite pattern basis.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.DirectionalConcrete`,

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_output_coeff_energy_eq {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) :
  ∑ p,
      ∑ r,
        ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
          ∑ a ∈ p.freshInRow r,
            NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.contract F c x
                (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair p (r, a) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one (r, c)
                  NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero) ^
              2 =
    ∑ z,
      NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.contract F z.right x
          (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair z.pattern (z.row, z.left) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one
            (z.row, z.right) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero) ^
        2
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_output_coeff_energy_eq
doc:
The corresponding exact marked-output identity for the transpose hop.

signature:

  NLAlib.SparseSketch.sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime m F.rows) x) ≤
    ↑nu * NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.markedEnergy NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero F x

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_output_fiber_le_marked {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) {nu : ℕ}
  {x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ} (hx : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.SupportedAtGrade nu x)

      (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.fiber (Matrix.mulVec (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime m F.rows) x) p) ≤

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprimeMarked_apply {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) (σ : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) (r : Fin m) (c : Fin n)
  (k : Fin d) :
  (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprimeMarked F x σ r c).ofLp k =
    ∑ a ∈ σ.freshInRow r,
      (F.u a).ofLp k *
        NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.contract F c x
          (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair σ (r, a) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one (r, c)
            NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero)

The marked heavy correction coefficient evaluates its transitioned input fiber.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprimeMarked_normSq_le {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)

  NLAlib.SparseSketch.euclideanNormSq (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprimeMarked F x σ r c) ≤
    ∑ a ∈ σ.freshInRow r,
      NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.contract F c x
          (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair σ (r, a) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one (r, c)
            NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero) ^
        2

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprime_wordKernel_apply {m n : ℕ} {r : Fin m} {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j)
  (out inp : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.wordKernel (r, i) (r, j) (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pDown, NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pUp) out inp =
    if
        out (r, i) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero ∧
          out (r, j) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one ∧
            inp =
              NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair out (r, i) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one (r, j)
                NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero then
      1
    else 0

The heavy correction word kernel has exactly the prescribed pair-transition coefficient.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.orderedHprime_mulVec {d m n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) (k : Fin d)
  (σ : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  Matrix.mulVec
      (NLAlib.SparseSketch.orderedWordTerm u r i j (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pDown, NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pUp)) x
      (k, σ) =
    if σ (r, i) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero ∧ σ (r, j) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one then
      ∑ l,
        u i k * u j l *
          x
            (l,
              NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair σ (r, i) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one (r, j)
                NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero)
    else 0
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.orderedHprime_mulVec

signature:

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.yPlus_wordKernel_apply {m n : ℕ} {r : Fin m} {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j)
  (out inp : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.wordKernel (r, i) (r, j) (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.rUp, NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pUp) out inp =
    if
        out (r, i) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.two ∧
          out (r, j) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one ∧
            inp =
              NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair out (r, i) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one (r, j)
                NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero then
      1
    else 0

signature:

  ∑ inp, (F.u i).ofLp inp.1 * NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rDownAt r i σ inp.2 * x inp =

        i
    else 0

  NLAlib.quadForm (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.DUp F) x =

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_Hzero {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) :
  NLAlib.quadForm (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Hzero m F.rows) x =
    NLAlib.SparseSketch.sumSq ((NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUpStack F).mulVec x) +
        NLAlib.SparseSketch.sumSq ((NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADownStack F).mulVec x) -
      (NLAlib.quadForm (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.DUp F) x + NLAlib.quadForm (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.DDown F) x)

signature: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sqrt_mul_sqrt_add_two_le (nu : ℕ) : √(↑nu + 2) * √↑nu ≤ ↑nu + 1
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sqrt_mul_sqrt_add_two_le
doc:
The square-root product of grades separated by two is bounded by the intervening grade.

NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.subset_analysis_le_card_mul {d n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (S : Finset (Fin n))

doc:

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sum_markedSite
doc:

  (f : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.MarkedSite m n b → ℝ) :
  ∑ z, f ((NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.markedTransition a b) z) = ∑ z, f z
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sum_markedTransition
doc:

NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sum_marked_reindex {m n : ℕ} (a b : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level)

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.weighted_gradeProjection {d m n : ℕ} (nu : ℕ)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) :
  ∑ p,
      ↑p.grade *
        NLAlib.SparseSketch.euclideanNormSq
          (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.fiber (Matrix.mulVec (NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection nu) x) p) =
    ↑nu * NLAlib.SparseSketch.sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection nu) x)

doc:

doc:
The row light creation synthesis matrix is the sum of its one-site summands.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_grade_relation

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_mul_cMatrix {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix F r * NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.cMatrix F r =
    ∑ i,
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        NLAlib.SparseSketch.orderedWordTerm F.rows r i j (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pUp, NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pUp)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_mul_cMatrix
doc:
Exact row-local factorization: the diagonal terms vanish by `P†²=0`.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_mul_transpose_decomposition {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (r : Fin m) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix F r * (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix F r).transpose =
    NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1Row F r +
      ∑ i,
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          NLAlib.SparseSketch.orderedWordTerm F.rows r i j (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pUp, NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pDown)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_mul_transpose_decomposition
doc:
A light synthesis co-Gram matrix splits into hopping and same-site diagonal corrections.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_transpose_apply {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
  (p : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) (out : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix F r).transpose p out =
    ∑ i, (F.u i).ofLp out.1 * NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pAt r i p out.2
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_transpose_apply
doc:
The transposed creation matrix has the corresponding annihilation entry formula.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack_restricted_gram {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.blockGram_of_pairwise_certificate {ell : ℕ} (hell : 1 ≤ ell) {d quadratic : ℝ}
  (energy diagonal : Fin ell → ℝ) (cross : Fin ell → Fin ell → ℝ)
  (hquadratic : quadratic ≤ ∑ i, diagonal i + ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, cross i j)
  (hdiag : ∀ (i : Fin ell), diagonal i ≤ d * energy i)
  (hcross : ∀ (i j : Fin ell), i ≠ j → cross i j ≤ (energy i + energy j) / 2) :
  quadratic ≤ (d + ↑ell - 1) * ∑ i, energy i
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.blockGram_of_pairwise_certificate
doc:
A precise scalar certificate for the shared-leg block-Gram step.

To instantiate this with operators `V_i`, take `energy i = ‖z_i‖²`,
`diagonal i = ⟪z_i, V_i† V_i z_i⟫`, and let `cross i j` be the ordered
off-diagonal quadratic-form contribution.  The three hypotheses below are
exactly the facts that still have to be supplied by an operator formalization:

* `hquadratic`: expansion of the quadratic form into its blocks;
* `hdiag`: `V_i† V_i ≼ d I`;
* `hcross`: the cross-map contraction `‖V_i† V_j‖ ≤ 1` followed by scalar
  Cauchy--Schwarz.

The conclusion is the `d + ell - 1` light-sector constant.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightSectorAbstract`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.exists_permutation_of_legal_move {m n : ℕ} (T : Finset (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Site m n))
  (ell : ℕ) (out inp : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.BlockPattern T ell) (k : Fin ell) (r : Fin m) (i j : Fin n)
  (htarget : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.canonicalLightWord T ell out k = (r, i))
  (hsource : ↑inp (r, j) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one)
  (_havailable : (r, i) = (r, j) ∨ ↑inp (r, i) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero)
  (hmove : ↑out = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.lightMove ↑inp (r, j) (r, i)) :
  ∃ tau,
    NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.domainOfWord k (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.canonicalLightWord T ell out) =
        NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.domainOfWord k (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord T ell inp tau) ∧
      NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord T ell inp tau k = (r, j)

doc:
Conversely, every legal Pattern-level move admits the unique labelled
ordering whose spectators coincide with the canonical output ordering.

b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghat_apply {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.orbit_legal_weighted_sum {m n : ℕ} (T : Finset (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)

  (∑ k,
      ∑ tau,
        if NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.OrbitCompatible T ell out inp (k, tau) then
          a (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.canonicalLightWord T ell out k).2 *

    ∑ r, ∑ i, ∑ j, if NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.LegalLightMove ↑out ↑inp (r, i, j) then a i * b j else 0

NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt_column_inner {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n)

  ∑ p, NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt r i p a * NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt r i p b =
    if a = b ∧ a (r, i) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero then 1 else 0

doc:
The same-site creation column has exactly the fresh-site projection as
its scalar Gram.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt_mul_pAt_apply {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m) (i j : Fin n)
  (out inp : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt r i * NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pAt r j) out inp =
    if
        inp (r, j) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one ∧
          ((r, i) = (r, j) ∨ inp (r, i) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero) ∧
            out = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.lightMove inp (r, j) (r, i) then
      1
    else 0

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.UniformExactSMainConclusions.exactColumnSparsity {n d : ℕ} {delta eps : ℝ}
  {F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d} {heps0 : 0 < eps} {heps1 : eps ≤ 1}
  (self : NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.UniformExactSMainConclusions delta eps F heps0 heps1)
  (X :
    NLAlib.UniformSparseSample
      (NLAlib.sparseColumnSparsity (NLAlib.sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps *
        NLAlib.sparseBlockRows d (NLAlib.sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
      (NLAlib.sparseColumnSparsity (NLAlib.sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n)
  (i : Fin n) :
  Fintype.card { r // NLAlib.uniformSparseMatrix X r i ≠ 0 } =
    NLAlib.sparseColumnSparsity (NLAlib.sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.UniformExactSMainConclusions.exactColumnSparsity

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.UniformExactSMainConclusions.mk {n d : ℕ} {delta eps : ℝ}
  {F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d} {heps0 : 0 < eps} {heps1 : eps ≤ 1}
  (operatorFailure :
    (NLAlib.uniformSparseSampleLaw ⋯).prob
        {X | eps < ‖NLAlib.SparseSketch.gramError F (NLAlib.uniformSparseMatrix X)‖} ≤
      delta)
  (oseSuccess :
    1 - delta ≤
      (NLAlib.uniformSparseSampleLaw ⋯).prob
        {X | NLAlib.IsSubspaceEmbedding (NLAlib.uniformSparseMatrix X) (NLAlib.SparseSketch.rowMatrix F.u) eps})
  (exactColumnSparsity :
    ∀
      (X :
        NLAlib.UniformSparseSample
          (NLAlib.sparseColumnSparsity (NLAlib.sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps *
            NLAlib.sparseBlockRows d (NLAlib.sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
          (NLAlib.sparseColumnSparsity (NLAlib.sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n)
      (i : Fin n),
      Fintype.card { r // NLAlib.uniformSparseMatrix X r i ≠ 0 } =
        NLAlib.sparseColumnSparsity (NLAlib.sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
  (qAtLeastOne : 1 ≤ NLAlib.sparseMomentOrder d delta)
  (sparsityStrict :
    ↑(NLAlib.sparseColumnSparsity (NLAlib.sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) <
      1356 * ↑(NLAlib.sparseMomentOrder d delta) / eps)
  (rowsStrict :
    ↑(NLAlib.sparseRows d (NLAlib.sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) <
      306456 * (↑d + ↑(NLAlib.sparseMomentOrder d delta)) / eps ^ 2)
  (bAtLeastTwo : 2 ≤ NLAlib.sparseBlockRows d (NLAlib.sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
  (rowsFactor :
    NLAlib.sparseRows d (NLAlib.sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps =
      NLAlib.sparseColumnSparsity (NLAlib.sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps *
        NLAlib.sparseBlockRows d (NLAlib.sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.UniformExactSMainConclusions delta eps F heps0 heps1

NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScaledFlatYVector_inner {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScaledIIDError
doc:
The hollow iid Gram error with the genuine exact-`s` coupling scale on
each whole column.  It is expressed through the existing block-first error so
the already-proved iid/Fock bridge can be reused literally.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.UniformExactSTransfer`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScaledIIDError_apply_grouped {b s n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
  (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (Y : NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.IidColumnSample b s n) (a c : Fin d) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScaledIIDError hb F Y a c =
    1 / ↑s *
      ∑ i,
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          (∑ g,
                NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScale hb ^ 2 *
                  inner ℝ (NLAlib.SparseSketch.unscaledYVector (Y i g)) (NLAlib.SparseSketch.unscaledYVector (Y j g))) *
              (F.u i).ofLp a *
            (F.u j).ofLp c

  NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScaledIIDError hb F Y =
    NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScale hb ^ 2 •
      NLAlib.SparseSketch.iidVectorError F (NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.toYArray Y)

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScaledIID_trace_moment_eq_product {b s n d : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.blockGram_finite_row_bound
doc:
A finite scalar row-majorization version of the block-Gram estimate.

One distinguished diagonal entry is bounded by `d * energy`; each of the other
`ell - 1` entries is bounded by `energy`. No operator-norm statement is hidden
in this lemma.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.ScalarBounds`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.blockGram_row_bound {d ell energy diagonal cross : ℝ} (_henergy : 0 ≤ energy)
  (hdiag : diagonal ≤ d * energy) (hcross : cross ≤ (ell - 1) * energy) : diagonal + cross ≤ (d + ell - 1) * energy
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.blockGram_row_bound
doc:
The algebraic last step in the block-Gram estimate `d + ℓ - 1`.

The operator-specific hypotheses (diagonal block at most `d`, each off-diagonal
block at most `1`) are deliberately represented as scalar premises here.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.ScalarBounds`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.block_gram_apply {s b n : ℕ} (Z : NLAlib.SparseStackSample s b n) (g : Fin s) (i j : Fin n) :
  ∑ a, NLAlib.sparseStackMatrix Z (g, a) i * NLAlib.sparseStackMatrix Z (g, a) j =
    NLAlib.SparseSketch.invSqrt s ^ 2 *
      inner ℝ (NLAlib.SparseSketch.signedBasis Z g i) (NLAlib.SparseSketch.signedBasis Z g j)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.block_gram_apply
doc:
One block Gram entry is its normalization squared times the signed-basis inner product.

NLAlib.SparseSketch.concrete_band_envelope {n d : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s)
  (hb : 1 < b) (shift : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Shift) :
  ‖NLAlib.SparseSketch.normalizedBand (s * b) F b shift * NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection nu‖ ≤
    NLAlib.SparseSketch.bandConstant *
      (NLAlib.SparseSketch.aTerm ↑d ↑nu ↑(s * b) + NLAlib.SparseSketch.bTerm ↑d ↑nu ↑(s * b) +
        NLAlib.SparseSketch.cTerm ↑nu ↑s)

doc:
The literal normalized `+2`, `0`, and `-2` bands all obey the common
`(3 + sqrt 2)` envelope.

b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalArrayLaw {b s n : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : NLAlib.SparseSketch.XArray b s n) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw (NLAlib.SparseSketch.YArray b s n)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalArrayLaw
doc:
Given every sparse selector, the iid vectors are conditionally independent
with the explicit one-column conditional laws.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.SparseIIDTransfer`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalBarycenter {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : NLAlib.SparseSketch.SignedHash b) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.EVec b

doc:
The finite conditional barycenter as a Euclidean vector.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.SparseIIDCoupling`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (s n : ℕ) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw (NLAlib.SparseSketch.YArray b s n)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw
doc:
First sample the independent selector array and then sample, conditionally
and independently at every site, its associated ternary vectors.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.SparseIIDUnconditional`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iidArrayLaw_expect {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (s n : ℕ)
  (f : NLAlib.SparseSketch.YArray b s n → ℝ) :
  (NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw hb s n).expect f = (NLAlib.SparseSketch.iidArrayLaw hb s n).expect f
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iidArrayLaw_expect
doc:
Consequently every real observable has the same expectation under the
conditional mixture and under the iid ternary-array law.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.SparseIIDUnconditional`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iterated {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (s n : ℕ)
  (f : NLAlib.SparseSketch.YArray b s n → ℝ) :
  (NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw hb s n).expect f =
    (NLAlib.SparseSketch.selectorArrayLaw hb s n).expect fun x =>
      (NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalArrayLaw hb x).expect f
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iterated
doc:
The expectation under the explicit mixture is the iterated expectation:
first over the selector array, then over its conditional ternary array.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.SparseIIDUnconditional`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (s n : ℕ) (y : NLAlib.SparseSketch.YArray b s n) :
  (NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw hb s n).weight y =
    ∑ x,
      (NLAlib.SparseSketch.selectorArrayLaw hb s n).weight x * (NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalArrayLaw hb x).weight y
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw_weight
doc:
The conditional array mixture has the explicitly weighted finite-kernel mass.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.SparseIIDUnconditional`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw_weight_eq_iidArrayLaw_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (s n : ℕ)
  (y : NLAlib.SparseSketch.YArray b s n) :
  (NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw hb s n).weight y = (NLAlib.SparseSketch.iidArrayLaw hb s n).weight y
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw_weight_eq_iidArrayLaw_weight
doc:
The conditional product mixture has, pointwise, exactly the iid product
mass.  This is the full finite-array marginal identity, not merely equality of
selected moments.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.SparseIIDUnconditional`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalYLaw {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : NLAlib.SparseSketch.SignedHash b) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw (NLAlib.SparseSketch.YVector b)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalYLaw
doc:
The normalized conditional law obtained from the explicit joint fiber.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.SparseIIDCoupling`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalYLaw_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : NLAlib.SparseSketch.SignedHash b)
  (y : NLAlib.SparseSketch.YVector b) :
  (NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalYLaw hb x).weight y =
    (NLAlib.SparseSketch.jointColumnLaw hb).weight (y, x) / (NLAlib.SparseSketch.selectorLaw b hb).weight x
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalYLaw_weight
doc:
The conditional iid-vector law is the joint mass divided by positive selector mass.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.SparseIIDCoupling`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_barycenter {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : NLAlib.SparseSketch.SignedHash b) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalBarycenter hb x = NLAlib.SparseSketch.selectorVector x
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_barycenter
doc:
The conditional Euclidean iid barycenter equals the corrected signed selector vector.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.SparseIIDCoupling`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_barycenter_coordinate {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : NLAlib.SparseSketch.SignedHash b)
  (a : Fin b) :
  ((NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalYLaw hb x).expect fun y =>
      NLAlib.SparseSketch.cB b * NLAlib.SparseSketch.yValue (y a)) =
    if a = x.1 then x.2.val else 0
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_barycenter_coordinate
doc:
Coordinatewise martingale identity `E[c_b Y | X=x] = X`.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.SparseIIDCoupling`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_convex_order {b s n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : NLAlib.SparseSketch.XArray b s n) (Phi : ↥(NLAlib.symmetricMatrices d) → ℝ) (hPhi : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ Phi) :
  Phi (NLAlib.SparseSketch.sparseSymmetricError F x) ≤
    (NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalArrayLaw hb x).expect fun y => Phi (NLAlib.SparseSketch.scaledIIDSymmetricError F y)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_convex_order
doc:
Pointwise conditional Jensen on the correct vector space of real
symmetric matrices.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.SparseIIDTransfer`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_cross_inner {b s n : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : NLAlib.SparseSketch.XArray b s n)
  {z z' : NLAlib.SparseSketch.ArraySite s n} (hzz : z ≠ z') :
  ((NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalArrayLaw hb x).expect fun y =>
      inner ℝ (NLAlib.SparseSketch.scaledYVector (y z)) (NLAlib.SparseSketch.scaledYVector (y z'))) =
    inner ℝ (NLAlib.SparseSketch.selectorVector (x z)) (NLAlib.SparseSketch.selectorVector (x z'))
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_cross_inner
doc:
Conditional independence plus the one-column barycenter gives the exact
cross-inner-product identity at distinct array sites.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.SparseIIDTransfer`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_expect_yValue {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : NLAlib.SparseSketch.SignedHash b) (a : Fin b) :
  ((NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalYLaw hb x).expect fun y => NLAlib.SparseSketch.yValue (y a)) =
    if a = x.1 then x.2.val * (1 - NLAlib.SparseSketch.p0 b) else 0
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_expect_yValue
doc:
The conditional iid coordinate mean is the support-corrected signed selector indicator.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.SparseIIDCoupling`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_matrix_transfer {b s n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : NLAlib.SparseSketch.XArray b s n) :
  (NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalArrayLaw hb x).barycenter (NLAlib.SparseSketch.scaledIIDVectorError F) =
    NLAlib.SparseSketch.sparseVectorError F x

doc:
Exact off-diagonal conditional transfer.  No diagonal term is present,
and the proof uses `i ≠ j` to invoke independence at two distinct sites.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.SparseIIDTransfer`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_traceEvenPower_order {b s n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : NLAlib.SparseSketch.XArray b s n) (q : ℕ) :
  NLAlib.traceEvenPower q (NLAlib.SparseSketch.sparseSymmetricError F x) ≤
    (NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalArrayLaw hb x).expect fun y =>
      NLAlib.traceEvenPower q (NLAlib.SparseSketch.scaledIIDSymmetricError F y)

doc:
The exact trace-moment comparison needed after the sparse--iid
conditional barycenter identity.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.TracePowerConvexity.conditional_traceEvenPower_order`,

NLAlib.SparseSketch.embeddedGram_eq_transpose_mul_self.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Fintype k] {n d : ℕ}

NLAlib.SparseSketch.embeddedGram_frameOfMatrix.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Fintype k] {n d : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ)
